independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

claims.claim: A keyboard and a mouse are input devices: they enter data and control signals into a computer.
A screen (display) and speakers are output devices: they turn the computer's data into something we can see or hear.

notes: safety: 'Which part sends information into the computer?' asks a 5-year-old for the abstract input concept ('जानकारी भेजता है अंदर'); too abstract for the youngest age. Use the concrete action ('With which part do we type letters?').
